svg.title: Daily GPP minus the pre-pulse mean, before and after a rain day, mean of the events per site and threshold (2, 5 and 10 mm).
svg.desc: Six panels, one per site. X axis: days since the rain day, -3 to 15 (local days). Y axis: daily GPP of the measured day half hours minus the mean of days −3 to −1, in µmol CO2 m-2 s-1. Lines: events with at least 2, 5 and 10 mm of rain on day 0; the 5 mm line has a band of ± 1 standard error (SE); a day with fewer than 5 events is not drawn. Values for the 5 mm events (mean ± SE, n events): Anttila: 15 events; day 0: −3.54 ± 1.01 (n = 14); day 7: 2.95 ± 1.40 (n = 3, not drawn); last drawn day 5. Särkisuo: 13 events; day 0: −2.57 ± 1.02 (n = 13); day 7: 1.16 ± 0.75 (n = 4, not drawn); last drawn day 6. Haltiala (Viikki rain): 14 events; day 0: −1.95 ± 0.84 (n = 14); day 7: −2.46 ± 2.84 (n = 2, not drawn); last drawn day 2. Qvidja: 24 events; day 0: −3.63 ± 1.07 (n = 18); day 7: 4.22 ± 2.14 (n = 7); last drawn day 11. Viikki: 16 events; day 0: −4.82 ± 2.03 (n = 6); day 7: 3.20 ± 0.89 (n = 3, not drawn); last drawn day 3. Maktau: 36 events; day 0: −0.21 ± 0.19 (n = 34); day 7: 0.32 ± 0.45 (n = 13); last drawn day 15. Pre-pulse value: 0 (horizontal line).
